paragraphs: Minyamin Saksanah. See the entry Binyamin Nanokhiyah.[^1]

notes.text: Minyamin (מנימין) and Binyamin (בנימין) are retained as different supplied name forms, without normalization. Saksanah (סקסנאה) and Nanokhiyah (ננוכייה) are tentative vocalizations; their reading and identification remain uncertain. Earlier machine OCR had מקסגאה and גנזכייה, which do not establish printed alternatives.
